items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: she traced, uh, the name Berensburg, uh, back... the name Berensburg came from the Count de Berensburg in France.

ctx.x: But you're mainly French, huh? Uh-huh. In all origin.

That's right. Uh, my, uh, in fact, uh, I had a friend of mine, a woman that was kind of a historian, used to come down to the club all the time, and she traced, uh, the name Berensburg, uh, back, uh, and tried to find out exactly what, what, uh, the name intrigued her, you know, Berensburg. Uh-huh. So, she came to the club one night, and she said, man, she says, Joe, she says, she said, I always thought you was a distinguished looking guy. She says, she says, you know, you, you, you've got royal blood in your…
I said, how about that? How about that? It made me feel good, you know. Okay.
